I've written the Team page feature, but none of it has been compiled or run. I could only write files in this session, so I couldn't open the fluent-html package to check its API. The fluent-html calls are from memory, so run `tsc` on the folder first.

**Files created:**
- `team/store.ts`: the in-memory member store, seeded with three members (owner/active, admin/active, member/invited), plus search, email lookup and adding an invited member.
- `team/validation.ts`: reads the invite form and checks it. Name is required, the email must be valid and not already on the team (case doesn't matter), and the role must be owner, admin or member.
- `team/views.ts`: the page, the search box, the member list with coloured status badges, the "no members yet" and "no matches for “…”" messages, and the invite form with an error next to each field.
- `team/handlers.ts`: handlers for the full page, the search results and the invite submission.
- `team/routes.ts`: a Fastify plugin that registers `GET /team`, `GET /team/members` and `POST /team/members`, all behind `requireAuth`. Register it with `app.register(teamRoutes, { requireAuth })`.

**How it behaves:**
- **Search:** typing refreshes only the member list, 250 ms after the user stops. Without JavaScript, the search box still works as a normal form and reloads `/team?q=…`.
